title: Returning Door Households: Change-Order Rate
content:
# Returning Door Households: Change-Order Rate

Window Replacement Contracts. A household's history with Entry & Patio Door Contracts sets a returning-household share on the change-order fee of its window contract.

**Rule.** The change-order fee is multiplied by a returning-household share: a household whose most recently closed Ridgeline door contract was closed at least 60 whole months (the long-standing month count) before the change order date takes the long-standing share of 0.5; a household whose most recently closed door contract was closed before the change order date but fewer whole months before it takes the recent-standing share of 0.75; any other household, including one with no closed door contract, takes a share of one.

The door contract read is the household's door contract in status closed with the latest closing date; the change order date is the date of the most recent customer change order on the window contract. The share multiplies the fee before it is rounded to the cent.

| Most recently closed door contract | Share |
|---|---|
| Closed 60 or more whole months before the change order date | 0.5 |
| Closed before the change order date, fewer than 60 whole months before | 0.75 |
| Closed on or after the change order date | 1 |
| No closed door contract | 1 |

## Hypothetical readings

- Door contract closed 2030-01-10; change order dated 2035-03-20 (62 whole months later): 0.5.
- Same door contract; change order dated 2034-06-20 (53 whole months later): 0.75.
- A household whose only door contract is still installed and not closed: 1.
